index idx_check_approvals_project: CREATE INDEX idx_check_approvals_project ON check_approvals(project_id, kind, state)
index idx_derived_origins_execution: CREATE INDEX idx_derived_origins_execution ON derived_origins(execution_id)
index idx_derived_origins_session: CREATE INDEX idx_derived_origins_session ON derived_origins(session_id, kind)
index idx_derived_origins_source: CREATE INDEX idx_derived_origins_source ON derived_origins(source_kind, source_ref)
index idx_eval_results_check: CREATE INDEX idx_eval_results_check ON eval_results(session_id, check_id, seq DESC)
index idx_eval_results_episode: CREATE INDEX idx_eval_results_episode ON eval_results(session_id, episode_id)
index idx_journal_event_at: CREATE INDEX idx_journal_event_at ON journal(event, at DESC)
index idx_request_envelopes_run: CREATE INDEX idx_request_envelopes_run ON request_envelopes(run_id)
index idx_request_envelopes_session_state: CREATE INDEX idx_request_envelopes_session_state ON request_envelopes(session_id, state)
index idx_session_checkpoints_at: CREATE INDEX idx_session_checkpoints_at ON session_checkpoints(session_id, at DESC)
index idx_session_relations_parent: CREATE INDEX idx_session_relations_parent ON session_relations(parent_session_id, created_at)
index idx_sessions_updated: CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_updated ON sessions(updated_at DESC)
index idx_source_fences_scope: CREATE INDEX idx_source_fences_scope ON source_fences(scope_kind, scope_ref)
index idx_task_state_inbox_session: CREATE INDEX idx_task_state_inbox_session ON task_state_inbox(session_id, seq)
table agent_steps: CREATE TABLE agent_steps ( session_id TEXT NOT NULL, step INTEGER NOT NULL, json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(session_id, step), FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) STRICT
table artifacts: CREATE TABLE artifacts ( session_id TEXT NOT NULL, hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(hash) = 71 AND substr(hash,1,7) = 'sha256:'), kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('log','diff')), size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (size >= 0), truncated INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (truncated IN (0,1)), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, data BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (session_id, hash), FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) STRICT
table check_approvals: CREATE TABLE check_approvals ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, project_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(project_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('check_set','check_spec','constraint_binding')), check_id TEXT CHECK (check_id IS NULL OR length(check_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), spec_digest TEXT CHECK (spec_digest IS NULL OR length(spec_digest) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), check_set_digest TEXT CHECK (check_set_digest IS NULL OR length(check_set_digest) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), constraint_ref TEXT CHECK (constraint_ref IS NULL OR length(constraint_ref) BETWEEN 1 AND 512), constraint_digest TEXT CHECK (constraint_digest IS NULL OR length(constraint_digest) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), binding_digest TEXT CHECK (binding_digest IS NULL OR length(binding_digest) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), approval_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (approval_epoch >= 1), approved_by TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(approved_by) BETWEEN 1 AND 40), actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(actor) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), decision_ref TEXT CHECK (decision_ref IS NULL OR length(decision_ref) BETWEEN 1 AND 512), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('active','revoked')), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK (kind <> 'check_set' OR check_set_digest IS NOT NULL), CHECK (kind <> 'check_spec' OR (check_id IS NOT NULL AND spec_digest IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (kind <> 'constraint_binding' OR (constraint_ref IS NOT NULL AND constraint_digest IS NOT NULL AND check_id IS NOT NULL AND spec_digest IS NOT NULL AND binding_digest IS NOT NULL)) ) STRICT
table derived_origins: CREATE TABLE derived_origins ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT CHECK (run_id IS NULL OR length(run_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('message','file','child_session','artifact','execution')), target_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(target_ref) BETWEEN 1 AND 512), source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(source_kind) BETWEEN 1 AND 40), source_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(source_ref) BETWEEN 1 AND 512), origin_class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(origin_class) BETWEEN 1 AND 40), derived_from TEXT CHECK (derived_from IS NULL OR length(derived_from) BETWEEN 1 AND 512), support_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unverified' CHECK (support_status IN ('unverified','verified','invalidated')), lineage_complete INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (lineage_complete IN (0,1)), execution_id TEXT CHECK (execution_id IS NULL OR length(execution_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), tool_name TEXT CHECK (tool_name IS NULL OR length(tool_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), args_digest TEXT CHECK (args_digest IS NULL OR (length(args_digest) = 71 AND substr(args_digest,1,7) = 'sha256:')), pre_ref TEXT CHECK (pre_ref IS NULL OR length(pre_ref) BETWEEN 1 AND 512), pre_unavailable INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (pre_unavailable IN (0,1)), post_ref TEXT CHECK (post_ref IS NULL OR length(post_ref) BETWEEN 1 AND 512), coverage TEXT CHECK (coverage IS NULL OR coverage IN ('complete','partial','unavailable')), outcome TEXT CHECK (outcome IS NULL OR outcome IN ('admitted','completed','failed','outcome_unknown')), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK (kind <> 'execution' OR (execution_id IS NOT NULL AND tool_name IS NOT NULL AND args_digest IS NOT NULL AND outcome IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (kind = 'execution' OR (tool_name IS NULL AND args_digest IS NULL AND pre_ref IS NULL AND pre_unavailable = 0 AND post_ref IS NULL AND coverage IS NULL AND outcome IS NULL)), CHECK (pre_unavailable = 0 OR pre_ref IS NULL), FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) STRICT
table eval_results: CREATE TABLE eval_results ( session_id TEXT NOT NULL, seq INTEGER NOT NULL, work_unit_id TEXT, check_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('test','build','schema')), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('passed','failed','error')), provenance TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provenance = 'runtime' OR provenance GLOB 'llm:?*' OR provenance GLOB 'human:?*'), fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, artifacts_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(artifacts_json) AND json_type(artifacts_json) = 'array'), at TEXT NOT NULL, episode_id TEXT CHECK (episode_id IS NULL OR length(episode_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), pre_fingerprint TEXT, post_fingerprint TEXT, spec_digest TEXT, approval_epoch INTEGER CHECK (approval_epoch IS NULL OR approval_epoch >= 0), episode_status TEXT CHECK (episode_status IS NULL OR episode_status IN ('open','closed','scope_changed','spec_unapproved','interrupted')), PRIMARY KEY (session_id, seq), FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) STRICT
table journal: CREATE TABLE journal ( seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, at TEXT NOT NULL, event TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL ) STRICT
table metadata: CREATE TABLE metadata ( key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL ) STRICT
table request_envelopes: CREATE TABLE request_envelopes ( request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(request_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), session_id TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT CHECK (run_id IS NULL OR length(run_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), step INTEGER CHECK (step IS NULL OR step >= 0), attempt INTEGER CHECK (attempt IS NULL OR attempt >= 0), purpose TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(purpose) BETWEEN 1 AND 40), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('admitted','answered','failed','unknown')), first_seq INTEGER CHECK (first_seq IS NULL OR first_seq >= 0), last_seq INTEGER CHECK (last_seq IS NULL OR last_seq >= 0), prev_user_seq INTEGER CHECK (prev_user_seq IS NULL OR prev_user_seq >= 0), last_assistant_seq INTEGER CHECK (last_assistant_seq IS NULL OR last_assistant_seq >= 0), pending_input_digest TEXT CHECK (pending_input_digest IS NULL OR (length(pending_input_digest) = 71 AND substr(pending_input_digest,1,7) = 'sha256:')), refs_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK (json_valid(refs_json) AND json_type(refs_json) = 'array' AND length(refs_json) <= 16384), tool_specs_digest TEXT CHECK (tool_specs_digest IS NULL OR (length(tool_specs_digest) = 71 AND substr(tool_specs_digest,1,7) = 'sha256:')), projection_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (projection_version >= 0), lineage_complete INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (lineage_complete IN (0,1)), fence_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (fence_epoch >= 0), answered_seq INTEGER CHECK (answered_seq IS NULL OR answered_seq >= 0), decision_json TEXT CHECK (decision_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(decision_json) AND json_type(decision_json) = 'object' AND length(decision_json) <= 256)), reason TEXT CHECK (reason IS NULL OR length(reason) <= 200), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK (first_seq IS NULL OR last_seq IS NULL OR first_seq <= last_seq), CHECK (answered_seq IS NULL OR state = 'answered'), CHECK (decision_json IS NULL OR state = 'answered'), CHECK (state NOT IN ('failed','unknown') OR reason IS NOT NULL), FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) STRICT
table session_checkpoints: CREATE TABLE session_checkpoints ( session_id TEXT NOT NULL, seq INTEGER NOT NULL, at TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(session_id, seq), FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) STRICT
table session_messages: CREATE TABLE session_messages ( session_id TEXT NOT NULL, seq INTEGER NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL, json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(session_id, seq), FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) STRICT
table session_relations: CREATE TABLE session_relations ( child_session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, parent_session_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(parent_session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(child_session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) STRICT
table sessions: CREATE TABLE sessions ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, provider TEXT, model TEXT, goal TEXT NOT NULL, metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL, final TEXT, usage_json TEXT, error_json TEXT , model_ref TEXT CHECK (model_ref IS NULL OR (instr(model_ref,'/') > 1 AND instr(substr(model_ref, instr(model_ref,'/')+1),'/') = 0 AND length(model_ref) > instr(model_ref,'/'))), agent_id TEXT CHECK (agent_id IS NULL OR (length(agent_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 40 AND agent_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND substr(agent_id,1,1) BETWEEN 'a' AND 'z'))) STRICT
table source_fences: CREATE TABLE source_fences ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope_kind IN ('session','source','privacy')), scope_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(scope_ref) BETWEEN 1 AND 512), epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (epoch >= 1), reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(reason) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('active','cleanup_pending','cleaned')), tombstone_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(tombstone_json) AND json_type(tombstone_json) = 'object'), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL ) STRICT
table task_state_inbox: CREATE TABLE task_state_inbox ( seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(json)), FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) STRICT
table task_states: CREATE TABLE task_states ( session_id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 1), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(json)), PRIMARY KEY (session_id, version), FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) STRICT
